answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Reaching the karst of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on slashing penalties scaled strictly exponentially relative to collateral ratio. Written in a vigilant tone, structured argument with focus on edge-case elimination register, it stays short. The signal holds work receipts rather than names, so the willow of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
